scaling.law: delta_f ~ LF^2/t, F_b ~ w t^2/LF, C ~ w L_el t, f ~ t/LF^2 (fixed layer thickness and field; Euler-Bernoulli bimorph)
scaling.note: thicker CTS plates give MORE stroke than 1/t predicts (NAC2225/2226): the law is conservative for thick plates; the PICMA pairs differ by up to 20 % (the datasheet tolerance)
scaling.label: CALC

selection.rule: lowest mean P1 oracle ratio at 35 deg, -20 % parts, 0.3 mm tremor (seeds 200-201, 4-12 Hz)
